name: Fourier Projection-Slice Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that generates attenuation-only images (X-ray-like) by exploiting the Fourier projection-slice theorem to compute projections in O(N^2 log N) time per view, avoiding the O(N^3) cost of digital compositing.
summary: Fourier Projection-Slice Volume Rendering is an indirect technique that generates X-ray-like projections by transforming volumes to the frequency domain, reducing per-view complexity from O(N^3) to O(N^2 log N).
